manifest.name: @openpresentation/opf
manifest.description: Canonical Open Presentation Format schemas, TypeScript types, local validation and composition; in Node, the file API and the CLI defaults register the pptx.gallery catalog of @openpresentation/gallery.
manifest.author: Open Presentation

scripts.build: node ../../scripts/reuse-build.mjs check || (pnpm run generate && tsup && node scripts/copy-spec.mjs && node ../../scripts/reuse-build.mjs stamp)

manifest.name: @openpresentation/opf-render
manifest.description: Deterministic local OPF renderer for SVG, PNG, and PDF output.

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run check:fonts && node scripts/run-tests.mjs && npm run build:browser-check && npm run check:runners && npm run check:changes
scripts.test:contract: npm run build && npm run check:fonts && node scripts/run-tests.mjs --suite contract && npm run build:browser-check
scripts.test:browser: npm run build:browser-check && node test/browser-check.mjs && node test/rich-tab-browser.mjs && node test/rich-tab-estimated-browser.mjs

manifest.name: @openpresentation/opf-pptx
manifest.description: Pure local OPF to PPTX export and PPTX to OPF import tooling.

scripts.test: npm run build && node scripts/run-tests.mjs && npm run build:browser-check && npm run check:runners && npm run check:changes
scripts.test:contract: npm run build && node scripts/run-tests.mjs --suite contract && npm run build:browser-check
scripts.test:browser: npm run build:browser-check && node test/browser-check.mjs && node test/packed-bundle-browser.mjs
scripts.test:furniture: node test/shared-furniture.mjs && node test/furniture-provenance.mjs && node test/slide-variables.mjs && node test/furniture-fields.mjs && node test/furniture-wrapped-date.mjs && node test/socials-furniture.mjs && node test/native-furniture.mjs

manifest.name: @openpresentation/gallery
manifest.description: The pptx.gallery catalog for OPF: layouts, themes, colour and font schemes, narratives, audiences, purposes and tones, registered with catalogs: [gallery].
manifest.author: Open Presentation
